body: Sakura Wars is Sega's PlayStation 4 adventure and action role-playing game, first released in Asia on 12 December 2019. Captain Seijuro Kamiyama takes command of Tokyo's Imperial Combat Revue, a company whose performers also pilot machines against demonic threats. The fictional 1940 setting joins theatre, relationships and combat within the same group. Kamiyama must help the company recover its standing while preparing for a tournament between Revues. The adventure gives time spent with the performers a purpose beyond dialogue, because the people sharing the stage are also those expected to fight together.

Exploration and dialogue allow Kamiyama to learn about the company and influence his relationships with its members. Those intervals sit beside action battles, where the machines and their pilots face a more immediate threat. The change from earlier tactical combat gives the revival another pace while retaining the importance of the cast between missions. A successful company requires attention to both kinds of activity. The player moves from the public performance to the personal exchange and then into battle, seeing different aspects of the same people rather than meeting separate casts for each system.

The project followed a positive response at Sega Fes in 2016 and became the first main Sakura Wars since 2005. Tetsuya Otsubo directed, Tite Kubo designed the principal cast and Kohei Tanaka returned to compose the music. Jiro Ishii and Takaaki Suzuki contributed to the writing, while guest artists supplied supporting characters. The international edition arrived in April 2020. Its revival gathers new and returning staff around the series' essential combination, using a different combat approach without removing the theatre company and relationships that make its imagined world distinctive.
